generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A time-bucketed derived representation can pass nominal tests while silently changing canonical interval boundaries, losing rounding conservation, or leaving historical derived state stale after a retroactive canonical mutation.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Allocate each calendar bucket independently after normalizing the interval end, and only refresh the current operational window after historical mutations.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: TEMP-SPAN-001 plus TEMP-RETRO-001: attack exact interval boundaries, rounded-total conservation, retroactive propagation across retained layers, and idempotent derived-effect repair.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Preserve canonical temporal boundaries and total conservation in proportional allocation; a historical mutation must recompute every affected retained representation without fabricating zero for expired source detail.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: For time-derived state, test a boundary-misaligned span, a long rounding span, a historical period outside the current window, a derived-only retained period, and an idempotent retry after canonical persistence.

transfer_cases.scenario: A synthetic subscription begins and ends mid-cycle across several buckets; exact boundaries and total are conserved.
A synthetic retroactive correction targets a period older than raw detail while a retained aggregate exists; retained derived cost is preserved and the ratio is recomputed.
